screen.seeu.title: SeeU Settings
screen.seeu.share_self: Share my proxy with other players: %s
screen.seeu.share_distance: Other players see my proxy within %s blocks
sodium.seeu.render_enabled.tooltip: Show player proxies beyond vanilla's entity-tracking range.
sodium.seeu.render_distance.tooltip: Maximum distance at which SeeU renders other players' proxies, in blocks. The server may limit this distance.
sodium.seeu.min_distance.tooltip: Minimum distance at which SeeU may replace an untracked player with a proxy. Set to 0 to use proxies as soon as vanilla stops tracking the player.
sodium.seeu.walk_animation_distance.tool: Animate walking on player proxies within this distance. More distant proxies remain visible with a static pose.
sodium.seeu.name_tags.tooltip: Show name tags above distant player proxies.
sodium.seeu.disable_vanilla_fog.tooltip: Disable vanilla distance fog while SeeU rendering is enabled. Fog from fluids and status effects is preserved.
sodium.seeu.share_self.tooltip: Allow the server to send your proxy to other SeeU players. This does not affect your visibility within vanilla's tracking range.
sodium.seeu.share_distance.tooltip: Maximum distance at which other SeeU players can receive your proxy, in blocks.
